script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Drama
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

A young woman, EMMA (20s), sits alone at a table, her laptop open in front of her. A waiter, MIKE (30s), places a steaming cup of tea on the table.

MIKE
(cheerful)
Your usual, Emma?

EMMA
(distracted)
Yes, thank you.

Mike gives her a small, sympathetic smile and walks away. Emma takes a sip of her tea, lost in thought.

INT. UNIVERSITY CAMPUS - DAY

Emma walks through the bustling campus, her mind consumed by her work. She stops at a bench and pulls out her laptop. Across the quad, she spots JESS (20s), her best friend, laughing with a group of students.

EMMA
(to herself)
I need a break.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - LATER

Emma sits in the same spot as before, but this time with Jess. They catch up on each other's lives, sharing stories and secrets.

JESS
(teasing)
When did you turn into such a workaholic?

EMMA
(smiling)
Since graduation, I guess. I just want to make something of myself.

Jess nods understandingly.

JESS
You'll do great, Em. But don't forget to take care of yourself.

EMMA
(serious)
I won't forget. I promise.

INT. EMMA'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Emma sits on her couch, surrounded by papers and notes. She's been working for hours, her eyes tired and red. She glances at the clock, realizing it's late. She picks up her phone and calls Jess.

EMMA
(voice trembling)
Hey, I'm sorry. I know I said I'd come over, but I just can't seem to stop working.

JESS
(supportive)
It's okay, Em. You know I understand. Just promise me you'll take care of yourself tomorrow.

EMMA
(sighing)
I promise.

INT. UNIVERSITY LIBRARY - DAY

Emma sits at a table, surrounded by students. She's deep in thought, her laptop open in front of her. Across the room, she spots an old man, HENRY (60s), reading a book.

EMMA
(curious)
Hey, excuse me, sir. I know this might seem strange, but I couldn't help noticing that you've been here every day for the past week. I'm Emma.

HENRY
(warm smile)
Nice to meet you, Emma. I'm Henry. I come here every day to write. It's my sanctuary.

EMMA
(surprised)
You're a writer?

HENRY
(nodding)
Yes, I've written a few novels over the years. But mostly I write to keep my mind sharp. What about you? What brings you here every day?

EMMA
(hesitant)
Just work. I'm trying to make something of myself.

Henry nods sympathetically.

HENRY
You will, Emma. But remember, it's important to take care of yourself.

EMMA
(smiling)
I will.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Emma and Jess sit at their usual table, sipping their tea.

EMMA
(excited)
Jess, I met someone at the library. His name's Henry. He's a writer.

JESS
(impressed)
Wow, that's amazing! What did he look like?

EMMA
(describing)
He was an old man, with a warm smile and kind eyes. He gave me some great advice about writing and taking care of myself.

Jess listens intently, her eyes shining with pride.

JESS
I'm so proud of you, Em.

EMMA
(smiling)
Thank you, Jess. I couldn't have done it without you.

Jess reaches across the table and takes Emma's hand.

JESS
You'll always be able to count on me, Em.

INT. EMMA'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Emma sits on her couch, her laptop closed in front of her. She glances at the clock, realizing it's late. She picks up her phone and calls Jess.

EMMA
(voice trembling)
Hey, I'm sorry. I know I said I'd take care of myself today, but I just can't seem to stop working.

JESS
(supportive)
It's okay, Em. We all have our days. But remember what Henry said? Take care of yourself. Why don't you take a break and come over? We can watch a movie or something.

EMMA
(smiling)
That sounds perfect.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Emma and Jess sit at their usual table, laughing and enjoying each other's company.

JESS
(teasing)
You know, you should take more breaks. You don't have to do it all yourself.

EMMA
(smiling)
I know, but it's hard to let go sometimes.

Jess nods understandingly.

JESS
I know how that is. But you have me, and Henry, and all the other people in your life who care about you.

EMMA
(grateful)
Thank you, Jess. I don't know what I'd do without you.

Jess smiles warmly and takes Emma's hand.

JESS
You'll never have to find out.

INT. UNIVERSITY CAMPUS - DAY

Emma walks through the campus, her mind at peace. She spots Henry sitting on a bench, reading a book. She approaches him and sits down next to him.

EMMA
(smiling)
Hi, Henry.

HENRY
(surprised but pleased)
Hello, Emma. It's good to see you again.

EMMA
(smiling)
It's good to see you too. I wanted to thank you for your advice. It really meant a lot to me.

HENRY
(smiling)
You're welcome, Emma. I'm just glad I could help. But remember, it's important not only to take care of yourself, but also to surround yourself with good friends.

EMMA
(smiling)
I will. And I have you and Jess to thank for that.

Henry nods, his eyes filled with wisdom and warmth.

HENRY
You have a bright future ahead of you, Emma. Don't forget that.

FADE OUT.

THE END
